verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ בְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל־ לְעוֹלָ֑ם אֵב֣וֹשָׁה פַלְּטֵֽנִי׃ בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·ḵā Yah·weh ḥā·sî·ṯî ’al- lə·‘ō·w·lām ’ê·ḇō·wō·šāh p̄al·lə·ṭê·nî bə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David In You O LORD I have taken refuge let me never . . . be put to shame save me by Your righteousness

verses.original: הַטֵּ֤ה אָזְנְךָ֮ אֵלַ֨י׀ מְהֵרָ֪ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י׀ לְֽצוּר־ מָ֭עוֹז לְבֵ֥ית מְצוּד֗וֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: haṭ·ṭêh ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā ’ê·lay mə·hê·rāh haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî hĕ·yêh lî lə·ṣūr- mā·‘ō·wz lə·ḇêṯ mə·ṣū·ḏō·wṯ lə·hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: Incline Your ear to me come quickly to my rescue Be my rock of refuge the stronghold . . . of my deliverance

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אָ֑תָּה סַלְעִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃ וּלְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְךָ֗
verses.transliteration: kî- ’āt·tāh sal·‘î ū·mə·ṣū·ḏā·ṯî tan·ḥê·nî ū·ṯə·na·hă·lê·nî ū·lə·ma·‘an šim·k̲ā
verses.literal: For You are my rock and my fortress lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name

verses.original: תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נִי מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑י כִּֽי־ אַ֝תָּה מָֽעוּזִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·ṣî·’ê·nî mê·re·šeṯ zū ṭā·mə·nū lî kî- ’at·tāh mā·‘ūz·zî
verses.literal: You free me from the net - laid out for me for You are my refuge

verses.original: בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā ’ap̄·qîḏ rū·ḥî pā·ḏî·ṯāh ’ō·w·ṯî Yah·weh ’êl ’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: Into Your hands I commit my spirit You have redeemed me - O LORD God of truth

verses.original: שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי־ שָׁ֑וְא אֶל־ יְהוָ֥ה וַ֝אֲנִ֗י בָּטָֽחְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: śā·nê·ṯî haš·šō·mə·rîm haḇ·lê- šāw ’el- Yah·weh wa·’ă·nî bā·ṭā·ḥə·tî
verses.literal: I hate those who cling to worthless idols . . . but in the LORD I trust

verses.original: אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת־ עָנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḡî·lāh wə·’eś·mə·ḥāh bə·ḥas·de·ḵā ’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯā ’eṯ- ‘ā·nə·yî yā·ḏa‘·tā bə·ṣā·rō·wṯ nap̄·šî
verses.literal: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion for You have seen - my affliction You have known the anguish of my soul

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־ אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ רַגְלָֽי׃ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב
verses.transliteration: wə·lō his·gar·ta·nî bə·yaḏ- ’ō·w·yêḇ he·‘ĕ·maḏ·tā raḡ·lāy ḇam·mer·ḥāḇ
verses.literal: You have not delivered me to the enemy You have set my feet in the open

verses.original: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר־ לִ֥י עֵינִ֗י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְכַ֥עַס נַפְשִׁ֥י וּבִטְנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ḥān·nê·nî Yah·weh kî ṣar- lî ‘ê·nî ‘ā·šə·šāh ḇə·ḵa·‘as nap̄·šî ū·ḇiṭ·nî
verses.literal: Be merciful to me O LORD for I am in distress my eyes fail from sorrow my soul and body as well

verses.original: כִּ֤י חַיַּי֮ כָל֪וּ בְיָג֡וֹן וּשְׁנוֹתַ֪י בַּאֲנָ֫חָ֥ה בַּעֲוֺנִ֣י כָּשַׁ֣ל כֹחִ֑י וַעֲצָמַ֥י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḥay·yay ḵā·lū ḇə·yā·ḡō·wn ū·šə·nō·w·ṯay ba·’ă·nā·ḥāh ba·‘ă·wō·nî kā·šal ḵō·ḥî wa·‘ă·ṣā·may ‘ā·šê·šū
verses.literal: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning my iniquity has drained my strength and my bones are wasting away

verses.original: מִכָּל־ צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַ֨י׀ מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֪חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י נָדְד֥וּ רֹאַ֥י מִמֶּֽנִּי׃ בַּח֑וּץ
verses.transliteration: mik·kāl ṣō·rə·ray hā·yî·ṯî ḥer·pāh wə·li·šă·ḵê·nay mə·’ōḏ ū·p̄a·ḥaḏ lim·yud·dā·‘āy nā·ḏə·ḏū rō·’ay mim·men·nî ba·ḥūṣ
verses.literal: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace and among my neighbors even more I am dreaded by my friends they flee when they see me on the street

verses.original: נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי אֹבֵֽד׃ כִּכְלִ֥י
verses.transliteration: niš·kaḥ·tî kə·mêṯ mil·lêḇ hā·yî·ṯî ’ō·ḇêḏ kiḵ·lî
verses.literal: I am forgotten like a dead man out of mind I am like a broken vessel

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי׀ דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֪וֹר מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י זָמָֽמוּ׃ לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י
verses.transliteration: kî šā·ma‘·tî dib·baṯ rab·bîm mā·ḡō·wr mis·sā·ḇîḇ bə·hiw·wā·sə·ḏām ya·ḥaḏ ‘ā·lay zā·mā·mū lā·qa·ḥaṯ nap̄·šî
verses.literal: For I hear the slander of many there is terror on every side They conspire . . . against me [and] plot to take my life

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ בָטַ֣חְתִּי עָלֶ֣יךָ יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אָֽתָּה׃ אֱלֹהַ֥י
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ḇā·ṭaḥ·tî ‘ā·le·ḵā Yah·weh ’ā·mar·tî ’āt·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hay
verses.literal: But I trust in You O LORD I say You are my God

verses.original: עִתֹּתָ֑י בְּיָדְךָ֥ הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד־ א֝וֹיְבַ֗י וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘it·tō·ṯāy bə·yā·ḏə·ḵā haṣ·ṣî·lê·nî mî·yaḏ- ’ō·wy·ḇay ū·mê·rō·ḏə·p̄āy
verses.literal: My times [are] in Your hands deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me

verses.original: פָ֭נֶיךָ הָאִ֣ירָה עַל־ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: p̄ā·ne·ḵā hā·’î·rāh ‘al- ‘aḇ·de·ḵā hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî ḇə·ḥas·de·ḵā
verses.literal: Make Your face shine on Your servant save me by Your loving devotion

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־ אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’al- ’ê·ḇō·wō·šāh kî qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā rə·šā·‘îm yê·ḇō·šū yid·də·mū liš·’ō·wl
verses.literal: O LORD let me not be ashamed for I have called on You Let the wicked be put to shame let them lie silent in Sheol

verses.original: שָׁ֥קֶר שִׂפְתֵ֫י תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה הַדֹּבְר֖וֹת עָתָ֗ק עַל־ צַדִּ֥יק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז׃
verses.transliteration: šā·qer śip̄·ṯê tê·’ā·lam·nāh had·dō·ḇə·rō·wṯ ‘ā·ṯāq ‘al- ṣad·dîq bə·ḡa·’ă·wāh wā·ḇūz
verses.literal: May lying lips be silenced [lips that] speak with arrogance against the righteous full of pride and contempt

verses.original: מָ֤ה רַֽב־ טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר־ צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם׃ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ
verses.transliteration: māh raḇ- ṭū·ḇə·ḵā ’ă·šer- ṣā·p̄an·tā lî·rê·’e·ḵā pā·‘al·tā ne·ḡeḏ bə·nê ʾå̄·ḏå̄m la·ḥō·sîm bāḵ
verses.literal: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You

verses.original: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם׀ בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: tas·tî·rêm bə·sê·ṯer pā·ne·ḵā mê·ruḵ·sê ’îš tiṣ·pə·nêm bə·suk·kāh mê·rîḇ lə·šō·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא לִ֝֗י חַסְדּ֥וֹ בְּעִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ Yah·weh kî hip̄·lî lî ḥas·dōw bə·‘îr mā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: Blessed be the LORD for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege

verses.original: בְחָפְזִ֗י וַאֲנִ֤י׀ אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י אֵלֶֽיךָ׃ בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י
verses.transliteration: ḇə·ḥā·p̄ə·zî wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî niḡ·raz·tî min·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·ne·ḵā ’ā·ḵên šā·maʿ·tā qō·wl ta·ḥă·nū·nay ’ê·le·ḵā bə·šaw·wə·‘î
verses.literal: In my alarm I said I am cut off from Your sight But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help

verses.original: אֶֽהֱב֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל־ חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו יְהוָ֑ה נֹצֵ֣ר אֱ֭מוּנִים עַל־ יֶ֝֗תֶר וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·hĕ·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh kāl- ḥă·sî·ḏāw Yah·weh nō·ṣêr ’ĕ·mū·nîm ‘al- ye·ṯer ū·mə·šal·lêm ‘ō·śêh ḡa·’ă·wāh
verses.literal: Love - the LORD all His saints The LORD preserves the faithful but fully . . . repays the arrogant . . .

verses.original: חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥiz·qū wə·ya·’ă·mêṣ lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem kāl- ham·ya·ḥă·lîm Yah·weh
verses.literal: Be strong and courageous . . . all you who hope in the LORD
